description.value:
You raise a wall of crystallised cosmo between your allies and whatever is coming.

You create a straight barrier up to 15 feet long and 10 feet high in an unoccupied space you can see. It has AC 10, Hardness equal to your level, and Hit Points equal to four times your level, and it blocks line of effect. The wall is destroyed when its Hit Points are reduced to 0.

Heightened (Ascendant) The wall's Hardness and Hit Points increase by half again. (Zenith) They double, and the wall reflects any spell that fails to breach it back at its caster.
